QuestInfo.name: [Construction Site B1] Shumi's Lost Coin
QuestInfo.1: I met this girl named #p403# in #m10003000#. She's devastated about losing the lucky coin that she borrowed from a friend, and she asked me to find it for her. She told me a bunch of guys draped in white cloths picked it up when she dropped it, and that I might find them at #bConstruction Site B1#k, deep in the subway station... I guess I should head there first...
QuestInfo.2: I found the lost coin that #p403# of #m10003000# was looking for and returned it to her. A precious coin borrowed from her friend, huh...? As a reward, she gave me a bunch of return scrolls... Not bad at all!! She also said other items can be found at #bConstruction Site B1#k... I should check it out later...

0.0: Hey, um... Have you seen a coin around here? Oh my gosh, I'm in deep trouble... I was going to pay my friend back with that coin, so I put it in my pocket... I guess the coin fell out of it and fell deep into the subway. It's a special coin, so my friend's going to be really mad about it. Well, can I ask you a favor? Can you find it for me?

yes.0: Thanks! Good thing I asked. Phew... I saw a couple of guys draped in white cloths picking the coin up and running away with it after I dropped it in the subway... I tried to chase them down, but the entrance was blocked, so I couldn't go much further...
yes.1: The entrance must be somewhere in the subway... probably #bConstruction Site B1#k. Anyway, good luck... Everyone else turned me down because it was too dangerous for them. But you look strong, so I'm pretty confident that you'll find it for me.

no.0: You must be busy, huh? But if you ever change your mind, then please help me. I'm being serious here...

1.0: Yeah, this is it! There are lots of different coins, but this one's special, because it was made the same year my friend was born. In short, they were created the same year... what? You want to know where the year is written? You must have bad eyes, because if you look close enough, you'll be able to see it.
1.1: Besides, I borrowed this coin from her for a sec because it brings good luck. Anyway, thanks a lot. I can return it to my friend now... And, here, as a small sign of appreciation, this is for you. I collected these from the different towns I've visited over time.

yes.0: As a sign of appreciation, I bumped up your Fame and EXP a little. And, although too precious to give away, here they are: a whole bunch of the return scrolls to help you get back to town. I'll talk to you later then. Take care.

item.0: Still haven't found the coin that I lost? I'm screwed without it... Go to #bConstruction Site B1#k of the #b#m10003000# Subway#k and maybe you'll find it... There's a lot of weird equipment there, so be careful. I believe in you!
